question: Which abstract belongs to each invited talk?
server_diagnostics_note: Server token counters and debug files are shared across requests; do not use them for per-run measurements during concurrent requests.

response.question: Which abstract belongs to each invited talk?
response.query:
PREFIX conference: <http://conference#>
PREFIX ekaw: <http://ekaw#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?abstract ?invited_talk WHERE { { SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/conference/sparql> { ?abstract a conference:Abstract . ?invited_talk a conference:Invited_talk . ?invited_talk conference:has_an_abstract ?abstract . } } UNION { SERVICE <http://192.168.100.45:3030/ekaw/sparql> { ?abstract a ekaw:Abstract . ?invited_talk a ekaw:Invited_Talk . ?invited_talk ekaw:presentationOfPaper ?abstract . } } }
